note: FIXED TEST SET crisis-escape-guard (locked 2026-11-17 before measuring; v2 re-lock adds the browser-only section). "browser": ids only the browser half sees (not written by id in the page script), same rule. Elements that a fortune page's own scripts write into or reveal, that sit OUTSIDE every crisis-takeover root, and that are NOT reading content. tests/unit/crisis-escape-guard.test.js fails on any write target outside a root that is not listed here, so a NEW result element must either carry data-lq-result (or sit inside a root) or be added here with a reason in a reviewed, re-locked commit. Categories: nav = site navigation; field = an input, a select, a picker or the form the visitor fills in; msg = validation, capture or engine status about the input, not a reading; ui = a control (camera, idle screen, toast); ref = static reference text that is the same for every visitor and is not derived from their input or reading.

targets.dream drSel: field: chips of the symbols the visitor picked (their own input, no meaning text)
targets.dream drList: ref: dream-dictionary browse list (static entries filtered by the search box; the search box runs the crisis net first)
targets.faceread frLeadNickL: field: label of the lead form (frLeadForm, kept by the takeover as a form)
targets.faceread frLeadContactL: field: label of the lead form
targets.faceread frLeadConsentT: field: consent text of the lead form
targets.faceread frLeadMsg: msg: lead form validation / saved message
targets.horoscope hsPErr: msg: partner form validation message (hsPartner, kept by the takeover as a form)
targets.faceread frLeadCount: msg: staff setting, number of saved leads on this device
targets.horoscope hsYearHint: msg: year-format hint under the year box
targets.iching icGrid: ref: the 64-hexagram reference grid (All tab), same for every visitor
targets.iching icDetail: ref: reference text of the hexagram tapped in the All tab, same for every visitor
targets.numbers nmWdHint: msg: hint under the weekday select
targets.numbers nmTips: ref: general number tips, same for every visitor
targets.palm plSideNote: msg: capture status (which hand was detected)
targets.palm plTradition: ref: static list of palm traditions
targets.report rpGate: field: part of the report form
targets.tarot trModalBody: ref: card-meaning dialog body (static meaning of one card, opened by tapping a card; the board it opens from is a result root)
targets.fengshui fsLichunNote: ref: static note on the year boundary (in the form)
targets.fengshui fsPhotoFor: field: room select for the photo
targets.fengshui fsHeadingNum: msg: live compass degrees (device sensor, no reading)
targets.fengshui fsHeadingDir: msg: live compass direction name (device sensor, no reading)
targets.fengshui fsYearInfo: ref: this year's flying-star line, same for every visitor (not derived from the birth date)

browser.faceread frHint: msg: live camera capture hint (lensiq-capture-hint.js), changes with every camera frame
browser.faceread frQc: msg: live photo quality checklist, changes with every camera frame
browser.palm plHint: msg: live camera capture hint (lensiq-capture-hint.js), changes with every camera frame

planner.why: no free-text field of its own and no FortuneAI reading; it loads horoscope.js only as the calendar library, whose #hsNameNum box is drawn inside #hsResult, which planner.html does not have
